lines.zh: 我穿着白袍，慢慢走过来。
lines.en: Wearing a white coat, I walk slowly over.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边低头看手里的板子。
lines.en: I walk with my head down over a clipboard.

lines.zh: 我的步子很规律，像在计时。
lines.en: My steps are very regular, as if timed.

lines.zh: 我绕过地上的箱子，没有抬头。
lines.en: I go around the crate on the floor without looking up.

lines.zh: 我从走廊那头接近，不快。
lines.en: I approach from the far end of the corridor, unhurried.

lines.zh: 我的袍子下摆扫过地面。
lines.en: My coat hem sweeps the floor.

lines.zh: 我走过灯下，镜片反了一下光。
lines.en: I pass under the lamp and my lenses flash.

lines.zh: 我迈着很轻的步子跟上来。
lines.en: I come after you with very light steps.
I pause at each step, as if recording.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙走，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I keep to the wall, trying to stay silent.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向挪，没有急。
lines.en: I shift toward you without haste.

lines.zh: 我来回走了两趟，像在等。
lines.en: I walk back and forth twice, as if waiting.

lines.zh: 我站着，在本子上写着什么。
lines.en: I stand writing something in a notebook.
I look up at nothing.

lines.zh: 我的笔停住了，一直没动。
lines.en: My pen stops and does not move again.

lines.zh: 我扶了扶眼镜，动作很慢。
lines.en: I push up my glasses, slowly.

lines.zh: 我站着，白袍上有一块污迹。
lines.en: I stand with a stain on my white coat.

lines.zh: 我把板子夹在腋下，等着。
lines.en: I tuck the clipboard under my arm and wait.

lines.zh: 我在数走廊里有几扇门。
lines.en: I am counting the doors in this corridor.

lines.zh: 我不说话，只有纸翻动的声音。
lines.en: I say nothing; only paper turns.
My expression has not changed at all.
I tilt my head as if thinking.
I stand very straight in place.

lines.zh: 我的手垂着，本子快掉了。
lines.en: My hand hangs low, the notebook slipping.
I wipe my lenses.

lines.zh: 我停在这里，像在等结果。
lines.en: I stop here as if awaiting results.
This spot under the lamp is for you.
I am recording you; keep still.
Your movements are worth watching.

lines.zh: 我低头写字，又抬眼看你。
lines.en: I write, then look up at you.

lines.zh: 你是第几个了？我记不清。
lines.en: How many have there been? I lost count.
I noted how often you blink.
I look at you through my lenses.
Do not worry; I am only observing.

lines.zh: 你身上有些数据我需要。
lines.en: There is data on you that I need.

lines.zh: 我一直看着你，这也是一种记录。
lines.en: I keep watching you; that is also a record.

lines.zh: 你的反应，跟我想的一样。
lines.en: Your reaction matches my expectation.

lines.zh: 嘴角抬了一下，没什么笑意。
lines.en: The corner of my mouth lifts, without mirth.

lines.zh: 你把头转开，我也记下了。
lines.en: You turn your head away, and I note that too.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿别走，很快的。
lines.en: Stand there and do not go; this will be quick.

lines.zh: 我问你一个问题，你必须回答。
lines.en: I will ask you something, and you must answer.
The way you look at me, I take note.
I do not need your consent.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，那是正常的。
lines.en: Your hands are shaking; that is normal.
You look like a specimen.
We still have some time.
I fall back half a step and keep recording.

lines.zh: 我的本子掉了，笔还在手里。
lines.en: My notebook falls, the pen still in hand.
You hit me and I look up at you.
I hold the wall and steady myself.
That blow made my handwriting slip.
One arm of my glasses comes off.
I cough once, muffled.
A dark patch spreads on my coat.

lines.zh: 我低头看伤口，像在看数据。
lines.en: I look at the wound as if reading data.
You did not follow the protocol.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，借我看看。
lines.en: Let me have a look at what you are holding.
I want that specimen.
Raise the lamp; I cannot see properly.

lines.zh: 你的同伴呢？我记着人数。
lines.en: Where are your companions? I keep a count.
You shut the door; excellent.

lines.zh: 你对这个有兴趣？我可以讲。
lines.en: Interested in this? I could explain.
That wound of yours is interesting.

lines.zh: 你把东西放在桌上就行。
lines.en: Just leave it on the table.
I want to record your voice.
Come two steps closer.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，我的板子掉了。
lines.en: We collide and my clipboard falls.
I hold your shoulder and straighten up.
You bump me and my coat creases.

lines.zh: 我被推得退了两步，还在写。
lines.en: Pushed back two steps, I keep writing.
My glasses go crooked; I straighten them.
One touch and my pen tip snaps.

lines.zh: 我们擦过，我闻到你身上的味道。
lines.en: We brush past and I catch your smell.
I block your way and do not move.

lines.zh: 你撞得很用力，我却不倒。
lines.en: You hit hard, and I do not fall.
After the bump, I pick up my notebook first.

lines.zh: 我是个研究员，不是那种东西。
lines.en: I am a researcher, not that sort of thing.
My interests lie elsewhere.
That question is not in the protocol.
I am recording; do not interrupt.

lines.zh: 我的本子里没有这一栏。
lines.en: There is no such column in my notebook.
I close my notebook and look at you.
I have no need for that kind of specimen.
You had better change the subject.
I put my pen away and do not answer.
I smile, very politely.
I pick it up and tuck it into my notebook.
I pick it up and hold it to the lamp.
I will keep this as a specimen.
I bend to pick it up, my coat dragging.
I hold it between two fingers.

lines.zh: 我把它放进衣服的内袋。
lines.en: I put it in my inside pocket.
I pick up my pen and check the tip.
This ought to be logged.
I set it on the table and align it.

lines.zh: 我捡起来又放回去，位置不对。
lines.en: I pick it up and set it back; wrong place.

lines.zh: 我把你登记为观察对象。
lines.en: I am logging you as a subject.

lines.zh: 我抬头，把注意力放到你身上。
lines.en: I look up and give you my attention.
I will follow this specimen to the end.
I have fixed on you; it is not a threat.

lines.zh: 你成为这一次的记录对象。
lines.en: You have become the subject of this record.
I close the notebook and walk toward you.

lines.zh: 你的行为模式，我已经有了。
lines.en: I have your behaviour pattern now.
Target confirmed: one living subject.
I raise my pen and point it at you.

lines.zh: 你在我名单的最后一行。
lines.en: You are the last line on my list.

lines.zh: 我选择你，因为你还没跑。
lines.en: I choose you because you have not run yet.

lines.zh: 我不需要理由，只需要样本。
lines.en: I need no reason, only a specimen.
Wherever you go, I record it.
You are within my observation range.

lines.zh: 这一次不会有人来打断。
lines.en: No one will interrupt this time.

lines.zh: 我把你的位置写下来了。
lines.en: I have written down your position.

lines.zh: 我一直走在你后面几步。
lines.en: I stay a few steps behind you.
You look back, and I am writing.
I have your route on paper.
You speed up, and I speed up slightly.
I make no sound except my pen.

lines.zh: 你躲进房间，我在门外等着。
lines.en: You hide in a room; I wait outside.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸频率我已经掌握。
lines.en: I have your breathing rate.
I stay at your rear quarter.
You look left, and I am on the right.
The tenser you get, the more data I collect.
I slowly shorten these few steps.
You stop, I stop, and I keep writing.
I need not run; you will tire.

lines.zh: 你走到哪儿，记录就写到哪儿。
lines.en: Wherever you go, the record follows.
I am waiting for you to decide.

lines.zh: 我穿着白大褂，可我不是人。
lines.en: I wear a lab coat, but I'm not human.
This observation is going well.
You cannot hear my footsteps.

lines.zh: 我隔着几步看你，笔没停。
lines.en: I watch you from a few steps off, pen never stopping.

lines.zh: 你往暗处走，我也跟进去。
lines.en: You walk into the dark, and I follow in.

lines.zh: 我扣住你的腕，翻过来看。
lines.en: I grip your wrist and turn it over.
I tap your hand with my clipboard.
That was light, only for confirmation.
I press you onto the table.
I jab with the tip of my pen.

lines.zh: 你挣了一下，我抓得更紧。
lines.en: You struggle once and I hold tighter.
I push you against the wall.
That blow came with the chill of a glove.
I hold your collar and do not let go.
One pull and you fall back half a step.
I pat your cheek so you look at me.
There was no feeling in that blow.
After striking, I pick up my pen again.

lines.zh: 你的反应，比我预计的慢。
lines.en: Your reaction was slower than I predicted.

lines.zh: 我扣住你的肩，按着不放。
lines.en: I clamp your shoulder and hold it down.

lines.zh: 我用本子的边角划了你。
lines.en: I cut you with the edge of my clipboard.

lines.zh: 我站在走廊尽头，一直看着。
lines.en: I stand at the end of the corridor, watching.
The white coat appears under the lamp first.

lines.zh: 我的白袍下摆，拖过地板。
lines.en: My white coat trails across the floor.

lines.zh: 我从门后走出来，拿着本子。
lines.en: I step out from behind the door with a notebook.

lines.zh: 你听到笔尖划纸的声音。
lines.en: You hear a pen scratching paper.
I appear when you turn.
My heels click on the steps.

lines.zh: 我站在柜子旁边，很自然。
lines.en: I stand by the cabinet, quite naturally.
I raise a hand and push up my glasses.
I begin recording this session.

lines.zh: 屋里多了一个穿白袍的人。
lines.en: There is one more person in a white coat here.
I step forward out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 我从另一间屋子推门进来。
lines.en: I push in from the next room.

lines.zh: 我先站在门边，等你发现。
lines.en: I stand by the door first, waiting to be noticed.

lines.zh: 我的白袍在暗处很显眼。
lines.en: My white coat stands out in the dark.
I step out from behind the bookshelf.
I pull out a chair and sit down.
I open my notebook under the lamp.

lines.zh: 我站在你的视线外，先看你。
lines.en: I stand outside your view and watch first.
I appear at the corner of the corridor.

lines.zh: 我拍掉袖子上的火，皱了眉。
lines.en: I slap out the fire on my sleeve and frown.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯上摔下，本子飞了。
lines.en: I fall down the stairs and my notebook flies.

lines.zh: 水进了我的镜片，我什么都看不见。
lines.en: Water gets behind my lenses and I cannot see.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的记录全吹散了。
lines.en: The blast scatters all my records.

lines.zh: 一支箭插在本子上，刚好挡住。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my notebook and stops there.

lines.zh: 法术照过来，我的笔迹自己变了。
lines.en: A spell passes and my writing changes itself.
I forgot to eat, and my hands begin to shake.
The lightning flash blinds me to you.

lines.zh: 虚空拉我，我的记录掉进去了。
lines.en: The void pulls me and my records fall in.
